answer.text: For Android, the manual says the app's minimum supported version is two versions behind the current Android OS.
For iOS, the manual says the minimum supported version is one version behind the current iOS release.
Huawei phones are not compatible with the app and are not supported.

disclaimers.text: The manual does not say whether a newly released phone OS version works with the app. Please confirm with an authorised Royal Enfield service centre.
